column1: # FRI verify vectors. Oracle: risc0-zkp 1.2.6 prove::fri::fri_prove / Verifier::fri_verify
# (Poseidon2 suite; verify/fri.rs value-identical to 3.0.4, which the node links — see
# fri_kat.rs version note). Streams byte-asserted against the untouched fri_prove; every
# vector, positive AND negative, replayed through risc0-zkp's own fri_verify before emission.
# rou_fwd/rou_rev: risc0-core BabyBear ROU_FWD/ROU_REV per po2 0..=27, CANONICAL form.
# Per case: initial_commit = 8 RAW digest words mixed before the FRI stream begins;
# proof = full word stream (round Merkle tops, final poly, per-query branches);
# qck:<q>,<r> -> <pos>,<g0..g3> = query q's (position, canonical goal) BEFORE round r
# (r=0 rows double as the inner(pos) map; r=rounds is the final-poly comparison state).
# inner convention (both sides): known pos -> recorded r=0 goal; unknown pos -> 0.
# badgoal:<q> (inner call q returns goal+1). final_off:<w> = first final-poly word.
